parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the wall cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the shelves and door.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure, holding the shelves and door in place while being mounted to a wall or surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides rigidity and stability to the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of MDF, used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space of the cabinet into sections, allowing for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable within the frame but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, providing access to the interior.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the cabinet to access or conceal stored items, often equipped with a handle for ease of use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to swing open and closed.
